successful_device_add_maximum.formula: 11 pre-orchestration + 16 stage entered/completed + 6 orchestration result/summary + 2 readiness + 4 lifecycle/mark-created + 4 terminal events

device_creation_failure_maximum.formula: entered + create-attempted + create-failed + pre-context 1713 + terminal + final-summary + returned-status

spinlock_creation_failure_maximum.formula: 11 pre-orchestration + 3 stage events + 6 rollback events + 7 result/taxonomy events + 4 terminal events

request_creation_failure_maximum.formula: spinlock failure maximum + completed spinlock stage pair

outbound_memory_creation_failure_maximum.formula: request failure maximum + completed request stage pair

inbound_memory_creation_failure_maximum.formula: outbound failure maximum + completed outbound-memory stage pair

rollback_maximum.formula: rollback stage-entered + rollback reason + started + object-before + completed + object-after

cleanup_maximum.formula: entered + 12 nonzero-counter events + cleanup snapshot + sequence-gap + schema-mismatch + cleanup-invariant + completed

terminal_maximum.formula: 12 nonzero-counter validation events + 1713 + success-or-failure + final-summary + returned-status

invariant_event_maximum.formula: bounded transition-gap + unexpected mapping + inconsistent object snapshot + counter overflow + schema mismatch; current operation-free paths cannot reach counter overflow

prohibited_nonzero_event_maximum.formula: 12 terminal validations + 12 cleanup validations; actual current production maximum is zero because the update helper has zero production operation callers

assumptions: One EvtDeviceAdd attempt follows one terminal path.
The orchestration stage enum remains bounded to nine non-NONE values.
Prohibited-operation counters have no production operation callers.
Diagnostic invariant events do not change production control flow.
